name: Fuji Media Holdings, Inc.
summary: Fuji Media Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese group operating through subsidiaries with a main focus on broadcasting, in Media & Content, Urban Development, Hotels & Resorts and other segments. Media & Content covers terrestrial and satellite television, radio, streaming platforms, content creation, gaming and music. Dating from 1957 with headquarters in Tokyo, it was previously named Fuji Television Network, Inc.
